entries.target: 通用 增加灵巧属性值

entries.source: I love the smell of death...
#GOLD#As the crystalline weapon and armour are brought together, they begin to emit a constant humming.
entries.target: #GOLD#当水晶武器和护甲被放在一起时，它们开始发出持续的嗡鸣。

entries.source: The stitched-together skins of many creatures. Some eyes and mouths still decorate the robe, and some still live, screaming in tortured agony.
entries.target: 缝在一起的许多人皮。有些眼睛和嘴巴依然待在这件袍子上，并且有一些仍然活着，在被酷刑折磨的痛苦中尖啸。
伊格兰斯的主要训练基地

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You feel a great hero watching over you!
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你感到有位伟大的英雄正在注视着你！

entries.source: This huge book is covered in slowly shifting patterns of ice. Yet they do not harm you.
entries.target: 这本巨大的书覆盖着缓缓流动的冰纹。但它们并不会伤害你。

entries.source:
You are attuned with Nature, and she helps you in your fight against the arcane forces.
		You gain 20%% permanent global speed, 10%% cooldowns reduction and do not trigger pressure traps.
entries.target:
你和大自然产生共鸣，在与奥术势力的战斗中受到她的赐福。
		你的全局速度永久提高 20%%，技能冷却时间缩短 10%%，且不会触发压力式陷阱。

entries.source: SPEAK UP, HAMBRAIN. I'VE JUST GOTTEN MY EARDRUMS BLOWN OUT BY YET ANOTHER BY-THE-PYRE POTION GONE SOUTH, REMEMBER? THRICE-DAMNED THING WAS GOING PERFECTLY, TOO. TOKNOR'S TACKLE!
entries.target: 说大声点，笨蛋！我的耳膜刚又被一瓶该死的药剂炸破了，记得吗？那该死的东西本来一切顺利！托克纳的钓具！

entries.source: You can find your character sheet online
entries.target: 你可以在网上找到你的角色面板。

entries.source: Very well. There is no hurry. But I will need to spend a number of days studying it before we can create your portal.
entries.target: 好极了，不用着急。要创造你需要的传送门我还得花上几天来学习一下呢。

entries.source: It can be used to activate talent %s (costing %s power out of %s/%s) :
entries.target: 它可以用于触发技能%s (消耗%s能量，总计%s/%s)：

entries.source: Keep a firm grip on it. These things will dig themselves right back into the ground if you drop them.
entries.target: 牢牢的抓住它，如果你不小心把它掉在地上，它会立刻挖地逃走。

entries.source: The staff carver spends some time with you, teaching you the basics of staff combat.
entries.target: 制杖师花了一些时间指导你，向你传授法杖格斗的基础技巧。

entries.source: Target is using %s telekinetically wielded weapon defensively and will block the next melee attack and retaliate.
entries.target: 目标正使用%s念力武器进行防御，能格挡下一次近战攻击并自动反击。

entries.source: This yeek has all sorts of two handed weapons to sell.
entries.target: 这名夺心魔出售所有种类的双手武器。

entries.source: Cause enemies within radius 6 to bleed for #RED#%d#LAST# physical damage over 5 turns (1/turn)
entries.target: 使6码范围内的敌人流血，在5回合内受到#RED#%d#LAST#物理伤害（1/回合）

entries.source: This cloak is fashioned from the scales of some large reptilian creature.  It appears to reflect every color of the rainbow.
entries.target: 这件斗篷用某些大型爬行动物的鳞片制成。它看上去可以反射出彩虹的每种颜色。

entries.source: The target is supercharged, increasing life regen by %0.2f and damage done by 20%%.
entries.target: 目标被超载，增加 %0.2f 生命回复并增加 20%%伤害。
艾格尼尔的血符仪式匕首

entries.source: inscribe your skin with the rune
entries.target: 将符文铭刻在你的皮肤上

entries.source:
<<<You feel a gentle warmth in your mind. Something speaks directly to your mind!>>>
#YELLOW#HELLO FRIEND. I AM A STAR FROM FAR AWAY. I HAVE HEARD YOU PRAISING YOUR SUN. WHY NOT PRAISE ME INSTEAD? I AM A MUCH BETTER SUN THAN THAT DULL, LIFELESS GAS ORB IN YOUR VICINITY. PLEASE, ALLOW ME TO DEMONSTRATE MY GOOD INTENTIONS.
entries.target:
<<<你在脑海中感受到一阵温和的暖意。有什么存在直接在你的脑海中对你说话！>>>
#YELLOW#你好，朋友。我是一颗来自远方的恒星。我听到了你对太阳的赞美。为什么不改来赞美我呢？比起你附近那颗枯燥乏味、毫无生气的气态球体，我是一颗好得多的太阳。请允许我向你展示我的善意。

entries.source: Inflicted with a fatiguing starlight, taking %d darkness damage and increasing the cooldown of a cooling-down talent by 1 whenever they act
entries.target: 受到疲倦星光影响，目标每次行动时会受到 %d 点暗影伤害，并使一个正在冷却的技能的冷却时间延长 1 回合

entries.source: You can only rush to a creature.

When you hit a solid surface, this spell tears down the laws of probability to make you instantly appear on the other side.
		Teleports up to %d grids.
		After a successful probability travel you are left unstable, unable to do it again for a number of turns equal to %d%% of the number of tiles you blinked through.
		The range will improve with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
当你击中一个固体表面时，此法术会撕裂位面将你瞬间传送至另一面。
		传送最大距离为 %d 码。
		在一次成功的移动后，你将进入不稳定状态，在基于你传送码数的 %d%% 回合内，无法再次使用该技能。
		传送距离受法术强度加成。
法杖 增加奥术伤害

entries.source: #YELLOW#You overcome intense #LIGHT_BLUE#REPULSIVE FORCES#LAST# as you traverse the Portal.
entries.target: #YELLOW#你克服了#LIGHT_BLUE#强大的阻力#LAST#，进入了传送门。

entries.source: Try to extract gems from which metallic item?
entries.target: 从哪个金属物品中提取宝石？

entries.source:
%s the level %d %s %s.
Difficulty: %s / %s
Campaign: %s
Exploring level %s of %s.
entries.target:
%s 等级%d，%s %s。
难度：%s / %s
战役：%s
正在探索楼层 %s，%s。

entries.source: Kyless, the one who brought the curse, is dead by your hand.
entries.target: 克里斯，那个曾经为你带来诅咒的人，死在了你的手上。

entries.source: The target calls upon its inner resources, improving all damage by %d%% and reducing all damage taken by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标召唤其内心的力量，提高所有伤害加成%d%%，减少受到的所有伤害%d%%。

entries.source: The target has been weakened, reducing all damage inflicted by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标被弱化，降低 %d%% 所有伤害。
